0|acd35a463cb2a8d2b28e094d718cf6e653ad7191|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"perf: Fix forgotten preempt_enable by nested writers
A writer that gets a reference to the buffer handle disables
preemption. When we put that reference
the outer most writer and if not
the head update to the outer most writer. The problem here
is that preemption is only reenabled by the outer most
produces preemption count imbalance for every nested writer
that exit.
So just don't forget to always re-enable preemption when we
put the buffer reference
Fixes lots of sleeping in atomic warnings
events recording.
